### 1 — Scene
A salmon meal with a creamy-looking herb coating, mixed leafy greens, cooked mushrooms and a few potato pieces, plus broccoli and cauliflower.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight and energy
The coating is included with the salmon. A small allowance for the visible sheen on the vegetables is listed separately as oil/dressing.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Salmon with creamy herb coating | 29% | 154 × 1.4 = 216 ml | 0.95 | 205 g | 230 | 472 kcal |
| Mixed leafy greens | 30% | 159 × 2.0 = 318 ml | 0.15 | 48 g | 25 | 12 kcal |
| Cooked mushrooms | 9% | 48 × 1.8 = 86 ml | 0.60 | 52 g | 60 | 31 kcal |
| Potato pieces | 5% | 27 × 1.2 = 32 ml | 0.65 | 21 g | 140 | 29 kcal |
| Cauliflower | 9% | 48 × 2.5 = 120 ml | 0.55 | 66 g | 30 | 20 kcal |
| Broccoli | 8% | 42 × 2.4 = 102 ml | 0.55 | 56 g | 35 | 20 kcal |
| Oil/dressing sheen | On items above | Approximately 4 ml | 1.0 | 4 g | 880 | 35 kcal |

**Area check:** 29 + 30 + 9 + 5 + 9 + 8 = **90% coverage**. The oil/dressing overlaps the food rather than covering additional plate area.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **452 g and 619 kcal** is plausible for this mostly covered dinner plate. The largest uncertainty is the salmon’s coating and added fat; the mushroom and potato identification is also less certain.
